name: 3904-comet-star-achievement
about: P-164: on a new file in EggStarGalaxy (scenario 1), cm-star places a PowerStar for the galaxy's comet star (Obj_arg0 4, its speedy comet; cm-probe reads both) where the player is put: the player takes it at once, and while its get sequence plays both First Star and First Comet unlock, before any next scene starts. A placed star does not appear in the comet scenarios themselves, so the test takes the comet's star in scenario 1; the achievement reads only which of the galaxy's stars is owned.
